coachFlags.text: Open heavier. First sets keep landing light — correct within the session, not across three.
Sleep and the 155 g protein floor are the primary limiters, unaddressed across every recent session.
Back: no loaded spinal hinging in Session A until symptom-free. Leg curl goes first; calibrate hip thrust / glute bridge.
Straps on deadlifts and rows — grip quits before the back does.
Stalled at 32 × 8, 8, 6. Hold 32 and hit 3 × 10 before moving to 35.
Lives in Session B. Open at 25 kg minimum, first or second in the order.
Right knee: depth under load is the historical trigger. Leg press is the primary quad compound if it flares.
